description: Get a public game's source from YouGame's own git: clone URL, the live build's commit and version tag, main ref, open crowd test builds, build steps, own-copy rule and how to send work back. Test builds are viewed on the game page; they are not git refs. A compiled web build (Unreal, Unity or Godot built to Wasm) that ships its project source in a source/ folder answers with that source as one ZIP download instead (source.download_url), for the live build and for each open test build that carries its own. Not every game has source: only games open to anyone's test builds, or bound by a licence, are expected to offer it, so "source not public" on a paid or owner-built game is normal, not a fault.
name: get_source
